scope: synthetic CPU single-player multi-parity goals; public development seeds, not HG-03 private evaluation
candidate_library: goal basis rows included but identity hidden from supervised selection; all candidate rows/decoys are six-coordinate parities
decision_gate: submit predicted k-bit code for +10 correct / -15 wrong; abstain 0; calibration Laplace((cal_correct+1)/(cal_n+2)) > 3/5

gates.sanity: rank matched bases rank k, test never used in fitting or decisions
gates.paired_padding: fixed-pool task-only predictions and calibrated decisions identical across core_140/padded_512/padded_1024 at each seed/rank/train size
gates.trained_vs_random: task-only n=16 beats mean of 100 random bases >=20/24 core_140 fixed-pool seeds at each rank
gates.raw_evidence: per-seed per-cohort per-rank rows, random rank distributions, source hashes, independently enumerated GF2 oracle

interpretation: synthetic feature-library selection; task-aware oracle is privileged ceiling; actual neural goal inference unmeasured
fixed_rng: Python random.Random on versioned seed/seed-slice strings; no Python hash randomization
